row.proto: void *Ne_Request_SaveOpKind1(void *save_system, void *out_handle, void *user, const char *save_name, uint64_t a5, void *a6)
row.notes: NeSaveSystem2 request: allocates a 0x110 op (0x14413a340 kind 1), checks save_name with the device's isValidSaveName (+0x70; else '%s' is not a valid save name for this platform, result 0x3f), copies it (max 31 chars) to op+0x50 with op+0x48 pointing at it, and queues the op. The op name is the save (container) name every device path is built from: remote names <title dir>@<name>#<file>, <name>@, <name>_backup# (0x144141c00). Called by the save manager job runner 0x14365bae0 with the request item's name (+0x28). Twin of Ne_Request_SaveOpKind2: the signature runs to the kind constant (mov r9d,1). Raised by native-1990 for the F1 1990 save separation (doc:/mnt/work/.f1-1990/addon/native-requests.md#N2).
